use ignore::gitignore::GitignoreBuilder;
fn main(){
 let mut builder=GitignoreBuilder::new(".");
 builder.add_line(None,"*.log").unwrap();builder.add_line(None,"!keep.log").unwrap();builder.add_line(None,"target/").unwrap();
 let rules=builder.build().unwrap();
 assert!(rules.matched("app.log",false).is_ignore());
 assert!(rules.matched("keep.log",false).is_whitelist());
 assert!(rules.matched("src/main.rs",false).is_none());
 assert!(rules.matched_path_or_any_parents("target/main.rs",false).is_ignore());
 println!("{} {}",rules.matched("app.log",false).is_ignore(),rules.matched("keep.log",false).is_whitelist());
}
